text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has brought me to the<n>shopping mall
today to do some<n>lackey training.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A respectable villain needs lackeys of<n>the highest
quality! So don't expect<n>me to go easy on you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm the boss, which means you have<n>to obey my
every command!
choice_data_list: Um... What will I be doing, exactly?
Um... What will I be doing, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna be getting in on the<n>action! Practice
makes perfect, after<n>all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First, head over to that discount<n>corner and haggle
the price down on<n>their stuff even more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Neeheehee! That'll really put 'em in a<n>bind!
choice_data_list: We shouldn't cause trouble for the shop!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What's that? Are you talkin' back to<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe that was too tough for<n>your current
lackey level. On to the<n>next mission, then!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I want ya to crash the<n>food-sampling corner
and devour all<n>the samples!
choice_data_list:
But what about the other customers who want a
taste?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Graaah! Is whining all you know how<n>to do?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bad lackeys need to be punished... by<n>having their
belly tickled!

Wait a moment, Windy. Do you<n>actually believe
you'll raise a loyal<n>lackey in that way?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Th-that voice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's Deadly Enchantress!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just regular Seeking the Pearl<n>right now.
But regardless, have a<n>listen!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You were about to punish your<n>trainer—or rather,
your lackey, yes?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's right. My lackey's gotta learn<n>that I got no
tolerance for<n>smart-mouths!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And did you stop to think about the<n>reason why
they were resisting?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The key to proper instruction is<n>striking a balance
between<n>punishment and reward! You won't<n>be
very effective if you only dish out<n>discipline.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I guess I haven't<n>considered offerin' any
rewards!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you know all sorts of stuff<n>about being a
villain, huh, Deadly<n>Enchantress!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then I take it you understand what<n>must be done...
yes?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First, a little treat! C'mere, lackey! I'll<n>letcha have
the strawberry from my<n>slice of cake!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aren't ya tired from all the walking<n>we've been
doing? C'mon, ya need<n>to eat something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's a good lackey. Eat it all up and<n>don't leave
any scraps!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now that your tummy's full, I bet<n>you're getting
sleepy, yeah? Time for<n>a nap in the park!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some time after that, Shinko<n>Windy continues to
dote on me in<n>various ways...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So what d'ya think?! How was that<n>for a reward?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You went well beyond my<n>expectations. And I mean
that in the<n>best way.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Neeheehee! Well, what can I say?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's the kinda stuff Mom and Dad<n>always do for
me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They praise me for racing hard and<n>then take me
out for some super<n>chewy steak!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They applaud me for waking up early,<n>and they say
I'm great for brushing<n>my teeth 'til they're sparkly
clean!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then you were already aware<n>of the lesson I
was trying to teach<n>you. I guess your trainer's in
good<n>hands!
choice_data_list: I'll be the best lackey I can be!
I wouldn't say no to more rewards.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Right! That's what I wanna hear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Work hard, and there'll be plenty<n>more rewards
waiting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you two make a great duo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
More? Hmmm... I guess I could pat<n>your head...
maybe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Windy. Rewards should be<n>given in
moderation, too. It's not good<n>to lean too far in one
direction.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! Which means...<n>it's time for
some punishment!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I hope you're ready, 'cause this is<n>gonna be
rough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Shinko Windy has<n>learned how to both
reward her<n>lackeys and dish out painful<n>discipline.
